title: Complete relationships/canon palette: seven rounds, content-edge correction and later threat-use/fade proposals
head: 2ddf2f0ea4b7d5eb10d7fc3a947d76da2739f748

reviews.classification: complete seven-round relationship/canon palette with explicit content-edge correction and later threat/fade additions
reviews.disposition:
All811input lines were read, including RLA–RLK, rounds2–6, RLAC16–RLAC18, the later RLEE10–RLEE13 threat rows and round7 RLU5–RLU8. The first Village-first/no-canon-consumer/ACT NOW none statements are dated October18 assessments. Current AD44 lead-first work, AD51 first useful seam and the later documented topic/memory/crowd routes qualify them; they are not a current ban on canon relationships or a requirement to consolidate every legacy store before a useful consumer. This review neither re-audits live source nor claims that the proposed general relationship/divergence engine exists.

RLA/RLB distinguish directed regard, beliefs/basis, role/culture, unmet needs and memory. A friendship can change a cause without replacing all canon ties or erasing a person's own agency. RLC/RLD/RLE require the actual dependency for changed learning, fights, choices and propagation; the illustrative Naruto chain and public-canon recollections still need the cited edition/era qualification before becoming sourced content. A role match does not license a different character's identity, speech, motives or powers. Death, mind control, resurrection and cross-life carriers must follow the actual world's mechanisms; broad statements that ties die or damp within two hops are ordinary examples, not universal prohibitions on persistent bonds, stronger influence or genuinely changed drives.

RLL's ten change channels and RLM's continuing goals/pressures remain useful ways to distinguish custody, information, teaching, offices, supply, time, place and AU premise. Natural reconvergence from surviving causes differs from an active fate mechanism and from an authored snapback. Truly resolved causes need no compensating disaster; strong success may persist. RLM7 pressure-era thresholds cannot erase an actual dated exam/season/calendar prerequisite. RLO's return-with-aged-cast wording is subject to the selected absence policy, whose default pauses inactive worlds. A fresh branch, a return to actual changed people and a world-crossing carrier have different identity and time effects.

RLN/RLQ baseline-plus-delta, fact dependencies, event statuses, generation freezing, golden runs, rebase/conflict review and settled-history compaction are proposed seams, not a verified universal schema or migration. The same immutable-baseline wording must not silently replace later corrected source input or the selected canon run. Rebase requires a concrete compatibility policy; old source-citation, retained command definitions and player deltas have separate authority. Compaction is valid only after accounting for real future readers; a summary cannot recover omitted exact source/action/history. RLN7's absorbed-span golden run is a proposed bounded regression, not proof that generated rows, actor-unknown mappings or an entire novel reproduce in play.

RLS/RLV/RLW and RLY/RLAI propose state/role-based content, templates, authored anchors and offline gap/horizon writing. They reduce branch-specific prose cost without implementing missing verbs, actual effect support or all emergent states. Their initial claims that every state runs on generic fallback are explicitly corrected by round6: fallback layers are not built and can remain too thin. Saving text does not settle game effects, and a live model remains a proposer under actual validation/persistence, with cost/privacy/visibility handled at the selected route. The save bible, fixed request schema, evaluator, horizon queue and private tailored prep are useful later ideas, not presently running automation, authority to read private saves or permission to dispatch agents.

Round6 corrects the earlier interpretation of the user: the main concern was unbuilt content, not merely outside meddlers. Preserve round5 as an adjacent palette while routing that question to RLCE1–RLCE14. Distinguish time/space/cast/divergence/mechanic/depth edges; unimplemented content is not a fictional law. A small unavailable verb need not park a whole branch. RLAC16–RLAC18 then refine the confident preflight/forecast language: represented dependencies can bound a check, not predict every emergent consequence; truth-driven stop conditions are distinct from player knowledge, and an unknown threat can act without advance disclosure. A real earlier committed stage retains its stock/time/effects if the remaining stage is parked. Closing a view is neither parking truth nor selecting another running world; continuation and unused time keep their actual owners. The old1366 target is superseded by current UI_RULES desktop evidence.

RLEE10–RLEE13 reflect AD50's capable-character threat use and several real means-based exits. These are not guaranteed universal rescue or forced equal scaling. The adjacent gain-never-free/automatic escalation phrasing must be read under AD5/AD25/AD28/AD38: actual costs and responding actors need a cause; effective protection, profitable repeat use or a defeated obstacle need not acquire a fabricated balancing tax. Fate's reserve/coincidence scheme, all-forces-one-module shape, near-end default, return route and no-offscreen-end wording remain local proposals qualified by actual world law, selected mode and means. External administrators may act through their world mechanism, not agent anti-exploit policy. Round7's familiarity fade and acquaintance caps are proposed world dials, off for the lead circle, distinct from kin/bonded ties and from the historically implemented memory episode/subject caps. RLU7's developer-described task scoring is not a verified formula, while RLU8 is an away-action continuity question, not an implemented list.

The useful social texture, causal channels, content-edge correction and optional authoring workflow remain here with original codes/history. Current [PROJECT](../PROJECT.md), [rules index](RULES_INDEX.md), [timeline owner](TIMELINES_AND_DIVERGENCE.md) and [relationship research](research/relationships-2026-10-10/REPORT.md) route selected work. No source qualification, new social rule, schema, runtime, private-save access, worker, deletion or acceptance decision is made by this reconciliation.
reviews.evidence: Actual full811line reading in six bounded contiguous ranges. Later self-corrections, all table cells and proposal/delivery boundaries reviewed. Compared with current direction and previously fully read chance/memory/topic receipts; no present runtime, source paragraphs, private saves, external reference or replay run.
reviews.reopen: Use current authority and selected real consumer; qualify source actors/era and preserve content-edge/knowledge/committed-stage distinctions before implementation. Retain original history and unresolved proof limits.
